ACo.caption: Template ID
ACo.doc: Starts with 'tpl_'. Find it in your DocSpring account, or with Find Templates.
ACo.name: templateId

ACp.caption: Template Version
ACp.doc: Optional. A published version such as 1.2.0 (or 1 for the latest 1.x.x), latest, or draft. Default: the latest published version (the draft when none has been published).
ACp.name: version

ACq.caption: Data
ACq.doc: The values of the template's fields, by field name. Use '/' for nested fields and lists, such as 'address/city' or 'items/0/name'. Date fields take dates as YYYY-MM-DD. For an image field, use 'image_name/url' with an image URL.
ACq.name: data

ACr.caption: Enable Booleans
ACr.doc: If enabled, any fields with the exact value of "true" or "false" will be parsed as booleans (true and false) instead of as text.
ACr.name: parseAsBoolean

ACs.caption: Test Mode
ACs.doc: Test PDFs are free, but they include watermarks. A test API token always makes test PDFs.
ACs.name: test

ACt.caption: Signature Requests (JSON)
ACt.doc: Optional. A JSON list of signature requests to check with the data, as in Create Signature Request's More Signers (JSON). auth_type is email_link when left out.
ACt.name: signatureRequests

ALh.caption: Emails to Signers
ALh.doc: With Signature Requests (JSON): who sends the signers their links, as in Create Signature Request. docspring: DocSpring emails each signer a link to sign, any reminders, and the signed PDF once everyone has signed. Each signer then needs an email address and the email_link Auth Type. A test submission can only email members of your DocSpring team. self: you send the signing links (see Signing Link Type), or people sign in your app. DocSpring doesn't email the signers of a form library template: choose self for one.
ALh.name: sendEmail

ALi.caption: Signing Order
ALi.doc: With Signature Requests (JSON). parallel (the default): everyone can sign at once. sequential: people sign one step at a time, in the order of their Signing Step, or of the signers. DocSpring emails each step when the one before it is done. When you send the links, send each step's once the step before it has signed, and make a new one with Create Signing Link if it has expired.
ALi.name: signingOrder

ALj.caption: Email Subject
ALj.doc: With Signature Requests (JSON) and DocSpring's emails: the subject of the emails that ask people to sign, such as Please sign the lease. Blank: "<your name> sent you <document> to sign".
ALj.name: emailSubject

ALk.caption: Email Message
ALk.doc: With Signature Requests (JSON) and DocSpring's emails: a message for the signers, shown above the signing button. Links and web addresses are shown as plain text.
ALk.name: emailMessage

ALl.caption: CC
ALl.doc: With Signature Requests (JSON) and DocSpring's emails: up to 10 email addresses, separated by commas, that get the signed PDF. They don't sign.
ALl.name: cc

ALm.caption: Days Between Reminders
ALm.doc: With Signature Requests (JSON) and DocSpring's emails: remind people who haven't signed every 1 to 30 days. Set Most Reminders per Person too, or leave both blank for no reminders.
ALm.name: reminderIntervalDays

ALn.caption: Most Reminders per Person
ALn.doc: With Signature Requests (JSON) and DocSpring's emails: from 1 to 10. Set Days Between Reminders too.
ALn.name: reminderMaxCount

ALo.caption: Reply-To Address
ALo.doc: With Signature Requests (JSON) and DocSpring's emails: where replies to the emails go: a member of your DocSpring team, or an address at one of your verified email domains. Blank: the template's reply-to address (the account owner when it has none).
ALo.name: replyTo

ALp.caption: Notification Emails
ALp.doc: With Signature Requests (JSON) and DocSpring's emails: up to 10 addresses, separated by commas, that DocSpring tells when the document is completed or declined, or an email bounces or can't be sent: members of your DocSpring team or addresses at your verified email domains. Blank: the template's notification addresses (the account owner when it has none).
ALp.name: notificationEmails

ALq.caption: Notify When Each Person Signs
ALq.doc: With Signature Requests (JSON) and DocSpring's emails: also email the notification addresses each time someone signs.
ALq.name: notifyWhenSigned
